titulo_es: El futuro en el pasado (was going to, was to, was about to, would)
descripcion_es: Hablar desde el pasado de algo que entonces era futuro: was going to, was to, was about to, would, was due to.
resumen: Para narrar lo que en un momento pasado aún estaba por venir, el inglés pone en pasado las formas de futuro. Cada una conserva su matiz: intención, plan oficial, inminencia o destino conocido a posteriori.

filas: Intención o predicción, a menudo frustrada
I was going to call you, but I forgot.
Futuro visto desde el pasado (estilo indirecto, narración)
She knew he would be late.
The minister was to open the new hospital.
The wedding was to have taken place in May.
We were about to leave when it started to rain.
was / were on the point of + -ing
He was on the point of giving up.
The train was due to arrive at six.
I was meeting Sue that evening, so I couldn't stay.

explicacion.texto: Was to + infinitivo tiene además un uso narrativo de «destino»: lo que, según sabemos ahora, iba a ocurrir después. Equivale al español «estaba destinado a» o «llegaría a»: He left school at fifteen; he was never to return.

items: Was going to sugiere a menudo que el plan no se cumplió: I was going to buy it, but it was sold out.
Was about to no se combina con expresiones de tiempo concretas: no «was about to leave at five».
Would es la forma habitual en estilo indirecto: He said he would help (dijo que ayudaría).

ejemplos.frase: I was going to paint the kitchen, but I ran out of time.
ejemplos.traduccion: Iba a pintar la cocina, pero me quedé sin tiempo.

ejemplos.frase: Little did she know that she would become the company's first female director.
ejemplos.traduccion: Poco sabía ella que llegaría a ser la primera directora de la empresa.

ejemplos.frase: The two leaders were to meet in Geneva the following week.
ejemplos.traduccion: Los dos dirigentes debían reunirse en Ginebra la semana siguiente.

ejemplos.frase: The bridge was to have been finished by 2020.
ejemplos.traduccion: El puente tendría que haberse terminado en 2020.

ejemplos.frase: I was just about to send the email when the power went off.
ejemplos.traduccion: Estaba a punto de enviar el correo cuando se fue la luz.

ejemplos.frase: They said goodbye at the station; they were never to see each other again.
ejemplos.traduccion: Se despidieron en la estación; no volverían a verse nunca.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: I knew she will be angry.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: I knew she would be angry.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: Desde un momento pasado, el futuro se expresa con would.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: I was going to call you but I have forgotten.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: I was going to call you, but I forgot.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: La narración sigue en pasado simple.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: We were about to leaving when he arrived.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: We were about to leave when he arrived.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: Be about to va con infinitivo; on the point of va con -ing.

ejercicios.frase: I ___ tell you the news, but you had already heard it.
ejercicios.explicacion: Intención pasada que no llegó a realizarse: was going to.

ejercicios.frase: The film was just ___ start when the fire alarm went off.
The concert ___ have taken place last night, but it was cancelled.
ejercicios.explicacion: Plan oficial no cumplido: was to have + participio.

ejercicios.frase: She promised that she ___ write every week.
ejercicios.explicacion: Estilo indirecto en pasado: will pasa a would.

ejercicios.frase: The plane was ___ to land at 10.15, but it was delayed.
ejercicios.explicacion: Be due to: hora prevista según horario.

ejercicios.frase: He emigrated in 1950. He ___ never to see his homeland again.
ejercicios.explicacion: Was to con sentido de destino: «nunca volvería a ver».

ejercicios.frase: I was on the point ___ resigning when they offered me a promotion.
ejercicios.explicacion: Be on the point of + -ing: estar a punto de.

ejercicios.enunciado: Completa con el verbo en la forma adecuada.
ejercicios.frase: I couldn't come to dinner because I ___ (meet) a client that evening.
ejercicios.explicacion: Pasado continuo para un plan ya organizado en el pasado.

ejercicios.frase: She said she will phone me later, but she never did.
respuestas: She said she would phone me later, but she never did.
She said she'd phone me later, but she never did.
ejercicios.explicacion: Como la promesa ya no está vigente, el futuro en el pasado es would.

ejercicios.frase: We were about to going out when the phone rang.
respuestas: We were about to go out when the phone rang.

ejercicios.frase: I intended to buy a new laptop, but I changed my mind.
respuestas: I was going to buy a new laptop, but I changed my mind.
ejercicios.explicacion: Intención pasada frustrada: was going to.

ejercicios.frase: The ship was going to sink at any moment.
respuestas: The ship was about to sink.
The ship was just about to sink.
ejercicios.explicacion: Inminencia en el pasado: was about to + infinitivo.

respuestas: The president was to visit the region in June
ejercicios.explicacion: Plan oficial en el pasado: was to + infinitivo.

respuestas: We knew it would be difficult
ejercicios.explicacion: Futuro visto desde el pasado: would + infinitivo.
